title: कक्षा चारको मेरो नेपाली किताबमा प्रयुक्त शब्दहरूको आवृत्तिको गणना {Kakshya Charko Mero Nepali Kitabma Prayukta Shabdaharuko Abrittiko Ganana}
nepali: शोधशीर्षक ः कक्षा ४ को “मेरो नेपाली किताब” मा प्रयुक्त शब्दहरुको आवृत्ति गणना शोधार्थी ः राधा पौडेल शोधनिर्देशक ः डा. पारसमणि भण्डारी विभाग÷क्याम्पस ः नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभाग, विश्वविद्यालय क्याम्पस, कीर्तिपुर शैक्षिक वर्ष ः २०५९–६१ ः पृष्ठसंख्या ः १११+९; अध्याय आठ प्रस्तुत शोधकार्य नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभागअन्तर्गत एम.एड. नेपा.शि. ५९८ पाठ्यांशको प्रयोजनको लागि प्रस्तुत गरिएको हो । यो शोधकार्य कक्षा ४ को “मेरो नेपाली किताब” मा प्रयुक्त शब्दहरू के–कस्ता छन् ? पाठ्यपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त शब्दहरूको आवृत्ति कसरी भएको छ ? उक्त पाठ्यपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त शब्दहरूको स्रोत र पदवर्ग के–कस्तो छ ? पाठ्यपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त शब्दहरू सरल र जटिल के–कस्ता छन् ? भन्ने समस्यामा आधारित छ । उक्त समस्याको समाधानका लागि निम्न लिखित उद्देश्य निर्धारित गरिएका छन्– “कक्षा चारको मेरो नेपाली किताब” मा प्रयुक्त शब्दहरूको स्रोत र पदवर्ग पहिल्याउनु, प्रयुक्त शब्दहरूको पाठगत विवरणको स्थिति देखाउनु र उक्त पुस्तकमा रहेका शब्दहरूको आवृत्ति गणना गर्नु । यो शोधकार्य शब्दभण्डारको आवृत्ति गणनामा विधिमा आधारित रहेको छ । उक्त पाठ्यपुस्तकमा प्रयोग भएका शब्दहरूलाई विधागत रुपमा वर्गीकरण गरी तिनको आवृत्ति संख्या निकाल्ने काम गरिएको छ । उक्त कक्षा चारको मेरो नेपाली किताबमा जम्मा १५७१ शब्दहरू रहेको पाइन्छ । आवृत्ति भएका शब्दहरू जम्मा ६६३ र आवृत्ति नभएका शब्दहरू जम्मा ९०८ रहेका छन् । पदवर्गका दृष्टिले हेर्दा नाम वर्गका शब्दहरू जम्मा ८४० (जम्मा शब्द सङ्ख्याको ५३.४६%), त्यसैगरी सर्वनाम जम्मा ४० (जम्मा शब्द संख्याको २.५४%), विशेषण जम्मा २८२ (जम्मा शब्द संख्याको १७.८५%), क्रिया विशेषण जम्मा ९८ (जम्मा शब्दसंख्याको ६.२३%), क्रिया जम्मा २२२ (जम्मा शब्दसंख्याको १४.१३%), नामयो.गी जम्मा ४१ (जम्मा शब्द संख्याको ६०%), संयोजक जम्म १९ (जम्मा शब्द संख्याको १.२०% र निपात जम्म २९ (जम्मा शब्द संख्याको १.८४%) रहेका छन् । त्यसैगरी स्रोतका दृष्टिले सवभन्दा धेरै तद्भव शब्द जम्मा ९२९ (जम्मा शब्द संख्याको ५९.१३%), त्यसैगरी तत्सम शब्द जम्मा ४९६ (जम्मा शब्द संख्याको ३१.५७%), त्यसैगरी आगन्तुक शब्द जम्मा १३७ (जम्मा शब्द संख्याको ८.७२%) र अनुकरणमूल शब्द जम्मा ९ (जम्मा शब्द संख्याको ०.५७%) रहेका छन् र शून्य आवृत्ति देखि अधिकतम २५० (हुनु) पटक सम्म आवृत्ति भएका शब्दहरू उक्त पाठ्यपुस्तकमा रहेको देखिन्छ ।
american_english:
Research title: A Frequency Count of the Words Used in Class 4's "Mero Nepali Kitab"
Researcher: Radha Poudel
Research adviser: Dr. Parasmani Bhandari
Department/campus: Department of Nepali Language Education, University Campus, Kirtipur
Academic year: 2059–61; number of pages: 111+9; chapters: eight
The present research work is presented for the purpose of the M.Ed. Nepa. Shi. 598 course under the Department of Nepali Language Education.
This research work is based on the problem of what kinds of words are used in Class 4's "Mero Nepali Kitab", how the frequency of the words used in the textbook has turned out, what the source and part of speech of the words used in that textbook are, and whether the words used in the textbook are simple or complex.
For the solution of that problem, the following objectives have been determined—to identify the source and part of speech of the words used in "Mero Nepali Kitab" of class four, to show the position of the lesson-wise detail of the words used, and to count the frequency of the words in that book.
This research work is based on the method of counting the frequency of vocabulary.
The words used in the said textbook have been classified methodically and their frequency numbers worked out.
A total of 1,571 words are found in the said Class 4 Mero Nepali Kitab.
The words that have frequency total 663 and the words that have no frequency total 908.
Looked at from the point of view of part of speech, nouns total 840 (53.46% of the total word count), likewise pronouns total 40 (2.54% of the total word count), adjectives total 282 (17.85% of the total word count), adverbs total 98 (6.23% of the total word count), verbs total 222 (14.13% of the total word count), postpositions total 41 (60% of the total word count), conjunctions total 19 (1.20% of the total word count) and particles total 29 (1.84% of the total word count).
Likewise, from the point of view of source, tadhbhav words are the most numerous, totaling 929 (59.13% of the total word count); likewise tatsam words total 496 (31.57% of the total word count), likewise loan words total 137 (8.72% of the total word count) and onomatopoeic-root words total 9 (0.57% of the total word count), and words with a frequency ranging from zero up to a maximum of 250 (hunu) times are seen to be present in the said textbook.

The words used in the said textbook have been sorted methodically and their frequency numbers worked out.
A total of 1,571 words turn up in the said Class 4 Mero Nepali Kitab.

informal_english:
Research title: Counting the Words in Class 4's "Mero Nepali Kitab" and How Often They Come Up
Researcher: Radha Poudel
Adviser: Dr Parasmani Bhandari
Department/campus: Nepali Language Education Department, University Campus, Kirtipur
Academic year: 2059–61; 111+9 pages; eight chapters
This research work is handed in for the M.Ed. Nepa. Shi. 598 course under the Nepali Language Education Department.
The whole thing is based on the question of what sort of words are used in Class 4's "Mero Nepali Kitab", how the frequency of the words used in the textbook has come out, what the source and part of speech of the words used in that textbook is, and whether the words used in the textbook are simple or complicated.
To sort that question out, the following objectives were set—to work out the source and part of speech of the words used in "Mero Nepali Kitab" for class four, to show where the lesson-by-lesson detail of the words used stands, and to count up the frequency of the words in the book.
This research work is based on the method of counting the frequency of vocabulary.
The words used in the textbook were sorted methodically and their frequency numbers worked out.
There are 1,571 words in all in the Class 4 Mero Nepali Kitab, as it happens.
The words that have frequency come to 663, and the words with no frequency at all come to 908.
Looking at it by part of speech, nouns come to 840 (53.46% of the total word count), pronouns come to 40 (2.54% of the total word count), adjectives come to 282 (17.85% of the total word count), adverbs come to 98 (6.23% of the total word count), verbs come to 222 (14.13% of the total word count), postpositions come to 41 (60% of the total word count), conjunctions come to 19 (1.20% of the total word count) and particles come to 29 (1.84% of the total word count).
In the same way, looking at where the words come from, tadhbhav words are far and away the most, at 929 (59.13% of the total word count); tatsam words come to 496 (31.57% of the total word count), borrowed words come to 137 (8.72% of the total word count) and echo-root words come to 9 (0.57% of the total word count), and you'll find words in that textbook that come up anywhere from zero to a maximum of 250 (hunu) times.
